component.name: igaos
component.description: Indigenous GPU-Accelerated Optimization Solver -- LP, MILP, QP, MIQP, NLP and MINLP, written from the mathematical foundation up in C++17 with no third-party numerical library.

license.name: See LICENSE -- team-owned, with a perpetual royalty-free grant to MRPL, ONGC, MoE and AICTE

properties.name: igaos:transitiveCveSurface
properties.value: none -- no third-party library is linked at any layer, so no CVE in a dependency can apply. This is a supply-chain property and explicitly NOT a memory-safety claim; see SECURITY.md.

properties.name: igaos:linkedOptimizationLibraries
properties.value: none -- not CPLEX, Gurobi, Xpress, COIN-OR, HiGHS, GLPK, SCIP, OSQP, BLAS, LAPACK, SuiteSparse or Eigen

properties.name: igaos:optionalToolchainComponents
properties.value: OpenMP (compiler runtime, optional, degrades to serial); CUDA toolkit (compile-only, never linked into the CPU build, kernels never executed on a device)

properties.name: igaos:benchmarkOnlyPythonPackages
properties.value: osqp, cplex, gurobipy, highspy -- used ONLY by scripts under bench/ to produce reference numbers. Not imported by the solver, the library, the CLI or the Python bindings, and not required to build or run any of them.
